acceptanceCriteria: The minimum proof wire is versioned and usable from a digest-pinned CI verifier through its canonical vectors and the in-repo second consumer; no independent interoperability claim (V1-0014 is post-1.0, decision 0373 answer 7).
Compact summaries and exact immutable drill-down ship experimental and opt-in, preserving uncertainty; the matched complete-task trial and default promotion are deferred to 0.8 (V1-0023, V1-0154).
Explicit local failure bundles reproduce admitted read-only results on a second checkout or expose exact missing inputs, while historical output cannot satisfy fresh verification.
The optional console exposes attributable hunk-to-evidence-to-requirement-to-verification links, explicit gaps and retained U4 operator-time evidence.
Three tested recipes cover understanding a change, preparing its review and digest-pinned CI verification using the qualified installed artifacts.
A versioned local provider authoring kit passes existing file/command transport conformance while preserving separate external evidence and the default local product boundary.

The five n8n-inspired additions have accepted owning contracts and recorded acceptance evidence; failed or unqualified experiments cannot be counted as delivered. Existing portable-proof and predecessor obligations remain required.

The 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap items (V1-0084..V1-0099) have accepted owning contracts and recorded measured evidence; items that fail their frozen evaluation or stay prototypes are archived as not delivered and removed from the release (V1-0083, decision 0373 item 13), and do not block predecessor obligations.

Application-flow understanding (V1-0100) has its experimental slice merged through normal review, its AFU-V0 spec indexed and traced, and its frozen browser evaluation still detecting the seeded defects; it stays experimental with complete:false reports and an explicit frontier unless the owner records profile acceptance, and it does not block predecessor obligations.
title: Corvint 0.7.0 portable proof and inspectable workflows
